title: Clues and traces
next_chapter_hook: Night wind swept across the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain. Chen Ji had just hidden the recorded Jade Slip when he saw the lights at the Elder's residence extinguish abruptly—Zhang Shen seemed to have sensed something.

text.content: After Su Qingyao left, Chen Ji stared at the Jade Pendant in his hand, faintly perceiving a nameless aura sealed within—this seemingly ordinary token was far from simple on the surface. He did not study it immediately but tucked it into his chest and turned toward the corner of the Servants' Quarters. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul trembled faintly in the depths of his consciousness, as if awaiting some opportune moment.

dialogue.content: "Boy, the thing inside that Jade Pendant—you cannot touch it for now." Mo Xiansheng's voice came like echoes from an ancient well, carrying a weight of gravity. "However, if you wish to verify what you suspect tonight, the Tianji Record can be used once more. Only—"

text.content: Chen Ji cut him off: "I know, it costs five points of Heavenly Fate." He sat cross-legged in the shadows where moonlight could not reach, taking out the yellowed fragment from his chest. The edges of the Tianji Record grew slightly warm, as if sensing the suppressed killing intent that had festered in his heart. Three months ago, he had already noticed something unusual about Elder Zhang Shen—it was not ordinary corruption, but something far more concealed and dangerous.

As the fragment unfolded, golden seal script moved like living creatures. Chen Ji closed his eyes and concentrated, sinking his consciousness into that chaotic mist. Three breaths later, his Brow Center jolted violently—scenes flashed like a carousel: at the third quarter of the Zi hour, Zhang Shen entered the Back Mountain Forbidden Grounds alone; at the beginning of the Chou hour, a black shadow slipped through a crack in the sect's barrier; at the second quarter of the Chou hour, the two交接ed some item in a mountain cave.

The moment the foresight vanished, an intense weakness surged over him like a tide. Chen Ji braced against the wall, cold sweat soaking his inner garments. Another five points of Heavenly Fate lost—now merely twenty-some remained. This was the most fundamental currency for his survival in the martial world. Yet the sneaky shadow of Zhang Shen in the vision made him almost certain: this powerful Elder who controlled the sect's daily affairs was secretly colluding with some external force.

dialogue.content: "Saw what you wanted?" Mo Xiansheng's voice carried no emotion. "Where that cave is, you should know in your heart."

text.content: Chen Ji offered no reply. Clutching his chest, he limped out of the Servants' Quarters and made his way toward the Back Mountain Forbidden Grounds under cover of night. The moonlight was obscured by heavy clouds, and the entire Tianqing Sect lay shrouded in deathly silence. His steps were extremely light, his breath almost merging with the night wind. Half an hour later, that secluded cave appeared in his view—its entrance concealed by vines, impossible to discover without亲眼所见.

The cave was deep and dark, with a faint lingering scent of spiritual incense—clearly an external sect's distinctive formula. Chen Ji traced along the stone walls, discovering a brocade box in a recessed area. He did not recklessly open it but wrapped it in cloth and tucked it into his chest. An暗纹 was carved on the box—a curled poison spider—a pattern he had seen in some record of evil sects, belonging to a secretive Southern Frontier force known for espionage.

dialogue.content: "Interesting." Chen Ji murmured lowly, the corner of his mouth slightly raised. "A Tianqing Sect Elder secretly connected with an evil sect force... if this news spread, the entire sect would be shaken to its foundations." He concealed the brocade box in his贴身暗袋 and continued searching the cave. In a corner, a Letter that had been left behind caught his attention.

text.content: The handwriting on the letter was neat and unfamiliar, yet its contents made Chen Ji's pupils shrink: "The third batch of supplies has been successfully transferred. The whereabouts of the Tianji Record are still under investigation. If the intelligence proves accurate, the fragment holder should be eliminated before breakthrough. At that time, the Old Sect Master will cooperate." The three words "Old Sect Master" splashed over him like a basin of icy water. His fingers trembled slightly—behind all this, there was actually Ling Yuan's shadow?

dialogue.content: "Found what you were looking for?" Mo Xiansheng suddenly spoke. "That 'Tianji Record whereabouts' mentioned in the letter—they are hunting you. And it is a death warrant."

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, folded the letter, and tucked it into his chest. He did not act rashly but quickly retraced his steps. The night wind was biting cold, blowing the cold sweat on his temples until it felt like ice. Upon returning to the Servants' Quarters, he retrieved the Jade Slip and recorded everything he witnessed and learned that night: Zhang Shen, the poison spider, the Southern Frontier force, Ling Yuan... each thread of evidence pointed toward an increasingly massive conspiracy.

choice.prompt: After deep nighttime contemplation, Chen Ji faced a critical decision: these clues pointed to Elder Zhang Shen colluding with external sects, even involving Sect Master Ling Yuan. How should he act?

choices.description: Hold your fire for now, bury the clues deep in your heart. Continue playing the fool, bide your time seeking more conclusive evidence, ensure a killing blow.
choices.visible_cost: Abandon the current opportunity to expose the truth
choices.visible_reward: Preserve strength, avoid startling the snake, obtain a more complete chain of evidence
choices.risk_hint: The enemy may accelerate their pace of action

text.content: Chen Ji concealed the Jade Slip in a hidden compartment, closed his eyes, and regulated his breathing. Since they wanted him dead before breakthrough, he would survive longer and build deeper than they imagined. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in his consciousness: "Teachability is good. A true hunter never rushes to pull the trigger."

choices.description: Deliberately reveal flaws before Zhang Shen, observe his reactions. Gauge through details just how much this person actually knows.
choices.visible_cost: May expose that you have discovered the truth
choices.visible_reward: Reverse-judge the enemy and ally situation through the other's reaction
choices.risk_hint: If Zhang Shen becomes wary, it may bring deadly danger
choices.process_label: deliberately slip up before zhang shen

text.content: Chen Ji deliberately "chanced upon" Zhang Shen the next morning, deliberately showing excessive interest in something. As expected, Zhang Shen's gaze flickered, then he ordered someone to deliver a pot of "Qi Supplementing Tea"—Chen Ji coldly smiled; the tea leaves were indeed laced with powdered slow-acting Spiritual Dispersal.

choices.description: Leave the sect overnight, contact the Demonic Path Saintess Ye Qing through special channels. She possesses the ability to conceal Heavenly Secrets aura, perhaps she can help him evade pursuit.
choices.visible_cost: Expose your whereabouts, may be detected by the sect
choices.visible_reward: Gain strategic support from the Demonic Path faction, reduce exposure risk
choices.risk_hint: Once dealings with the Demonic Path are exposed, you will become the target of all
choices.process_label: leave sect to contact ye qing

text.content: After hearing Chen Ji's account, Ye Qing tapped her finger against the table: "Interesting—Old Sect Master personally entering the game... the chess game is bigger than I imagined." She produced a black token from her sleeve. "Take this. The next time before you use foresight, crush it. It can conceal your aura once."

Just as Chen Ji was deep in thought, a faint sound of footsteps suddenly came through the window. He immediately suppressed his aura, stuffing the Jade Slip under his pillow. The footsteps paused at the door for a moment, then faded away. Chen Ji narrowed his eyes—that gait was all too familiar—the very heart subordinate manager that served Zhang Shen. His late-night visit here was by no means coincidence.

Chen Ji silently peered through the window crack. The manager stood beneath the moonlight, in low conversation with another black shadow. Too far to hear the content, but that black shadow's attire... was clearly Outer Disciple robes. After their brief exchange, the shadow handed over a package, and the manager departed in haste.

dialogue.content: "Zhang Shen has planted informants within the sect—not just one." Mo Xiansheng's voice drifted up. "Boy, you now know enough. Whether to continue digging deeper or temporarily retract your claws—that is your decision. But remember one thing—the further along the chess game, the greater the cost of each move."

choice.prompt: Deep night fell, and the secret meeting between the manager and the shadow concluded. Chen Ji needed to decide: continue investigating Zhang Shen's network, or temporarily sheathe his blade?

choices.description: Follow that manager under cover of night, see where he delivers the package. Perhaps you can follow the vines to find Zhang Shen's contact points within the sect.
choices.risk_hint: If discovered, it will alert the target

text.content: Chen Ji deployed his light skill, gliding silently along the eaves. The manager turned and twisted through seven or eight turns, finally stopping before a remote courtyard on the Back Mountain—the abandoned Outer Sect storage room. The manager knocked three times, someone inside took the package, and the light went out.

choices.description: Tonight has already yielded too much. Acting rashly would be unwise. Return to rest, continue observation tomorrow with your normal identity.
choices.visible_cost: Miss the opportunity for that night's investigation
choices.visible_reward: Preserve energy, analyze the situation tomorrow with a clearer mind
choices.risk_hint: Clues may be lost over time

text.content: Chen Ji slipped back to the Servants' Quarters, locking doors and windows. He did not immediately sleep but took out the Jade Pendant to examine—Su Qingyao's token, its inner mysterious aura now pulsed slightly, as if responding to his state of mind.

Regardless of the choice, the night's harvest already far exceeded expectations. Chen Ji lay on his couch, his mind constantly replaying those visions: Zhang Shen's sneaky figure, the Southern Frontier poison spider emblem, Ling Yuan's name... each thread of evidence was like a fine silk, weaving into a vast web whose full picture he could not yet discern. And he himself stood at the center of this web.

Mo Xiansheng's voice rose from the depths of his consciousness, carrying rare praise: "To maintain calm judgment with Heavenly Fate nearly depleted, you far surpass the previous generation's inheritor." Chen Ji offered no reply, only gripping the Jade Pendant in his palm, feeling its faint warmth. Outside the window, night was deep and heavy. In the direction of the Elder residence, the lights suddenly went out.

Chen Ji narrowed his eyes, gazing toward that direction swallowed by darkness. The timing of the extinguished lights was too coincidental—precisely shortly after he left the Back Mountain. He slowly exhaled a breath of turbid air, muttering to himself: "It seems someone has already sensed something." He concealed the Jade Slip in his贴身夹层, flipped over to feign sleep, yet his fingers remained resting on the edge of that Tianji Record fragment beneath his pillow, ready at any moment to respond to whatever might come.
